title: T036 deny-by-default content-block renderer registry is reviewable
summary: Starting from main@d3efe73, T036 adds a static registry and renderer for the 11 canonical v1 block types. Unknown block types, unsupported block versions and unknown generative presets fail closed to a poster identity plus bounded plain-text summary and emit deduplicated telemetry codes. T039 and all unrelated task state remain unchanged. Exact-head CI #453, Security #454 and browser job 94334940909 passed on head 803e78b; human review and protected merge remain.

claims.text: The article page now delegates block rendering to ContentDocumentRenderer.vue through a static registry; content cannot select a module or component.
Unknown types, unsupported block versions and unknown generative presets resolve to attributable fallback telemetry codes.
The fallback never uses a content-supplied URL and renders only a bounded plain-text summary.
Local web tests 63/63, lint, typecheck, Prettier and production build pass; local browser execution is unavailable because Chromium is not installed.
T039 remains checked and T034-T035, T037-T041, T056, T057+ and Web3/deployment/migration state are outside this change.
Protected exact-head CI #452, Security #453 and browser job 94333313832 passed on head 5b1e070; T036 remains reviewable pending human review and protected merge.
